name: PipelineRun State Model
global_rules: Per-code comment: per-job run lifecycle is separate from the global orchestration FSM.
STABLE sets accepted/releaseable true; FREEZE sets both false.
State changes persist an FSM_TRANSITION EventLog entry inside a serializable DB transaction.
invalid_transition_behavior: Observed setter does not itself validate a transition table; callers/control layers must provide legality.
notes: Do not promote this implementation-only model into source canon without authority review.
This model is registered to prevent accidental conflation with Queue Job FSM and DOC-C Execution FSM.
